project_type: Portfolio CMS - Architecture, Heritage & Theatre (USP India)
context: Architectural heritage restoration portfolio & theatre research CMS app
theme: Light theme (Organic & Earthy / Swiss Heritage Hybrid with warm stone base and deep maroon/red accent lines)

typography.heading_font: Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond / Custom Heritage Serif

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-serif
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-serif font-semibold
hierarchy.caption_labels: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-sans font-semibold text-neutral-600

typography.font_preservation: Strictly preserve existing live web fonts. Do not override global fonts for content blocks.

rules.tinted_greys: Never use pure #000000 or plain gray. Base neutrals carry warm stone/sand undertones.
rules.contrast_ratio: APCA & WCAG AA compliant. All body text at least 4.5:1 ratio against background.

visual_enhancers.accent_lines: Red accent bar (#C5221F or #B91C1C) placed above section headers (e.g. above 'Theatre Over Time') matching site accent style. Section headers and accent lines are glued so text and line move together.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp subtle borders. Remove outdated grey horizontal rules (#about block4 border or unnecessary footer dividers).
visual_enhancers.spacing_fixes: Eliminate stale fixed heights (e.g. _section.height765 leaving 134px empty outer block + 84px padding) before About footer. Reduce desktop bottom spacing to ~48px and mobile to ~24px.

grids.type: Flexible Responsive Grid & Fluid CMS Sections
grids.rules: Mobile-first layout (`grid-cols-1`). Direct grid children for proper alignment and smooth editor interactions.

layouts.who_we_are_footer: Clean, tight transition to footer without orphaned horizontal rules or empty ~134px gaps.
layouts.haveli_section: Dedicated new section titled 'A HAVELI BROUGHT BACK INTO USE' added directly following 'Its architecture, materials...' paragraph section, reusing existing CSS #haveli-in-use block styles while keeping existing paragraphs unaltered.
layouts.theatre_section: Red accent line positioned directly ABOVE 'Theatre Over Time' heading, coupled tightly so heading and line transform/move together.

motion.micro_interactions: Smooth transition (0.2s ease) on buttons, editor selection toolbars, hover effects.
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all ambient effects.

accessibility.testing_ids: All interactive elements and content controls MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='haveli-section-title', data-testid='theatre-over-time-heading').

hero_and_gallery.description: Restored heritage haveli architecture exterior and masonry
Theatre performance stage and archival work

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In Who We Are / About bottom section, remove unwanted grey horizontal rule and remove obsolete fixed height (_section.height765) to fix excessive spacing before footer.
2. Add a new section for 'A HAVELI BROUGHT BACK INTO USE' immediately after the 'Its architecture, materials...' section, keeping all original text intact and utilizing #haveli-in-use styling.
3. Add a red accent line directly ABOVE 'Theatre Over Time' heading in the Theatre section matching existing site accent styling. Ensure text and line move together dynamically.
4. Preserve live site fonts, existing color schemes, and ensure all key elements carry role-based data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default gradients.
Ensure 2-3x generous spacing in content blocks without leaving orphaned dead-space containers.
All interactive and key text components must have explicit data-testid attributes.
Do not break live font references or overwrite key heritage brand styling.
